title: 02/21/20 - Software Updates
content:
## 02/21/20 - Software Updates


Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000067694

We made updates to several Default Widgets this week. If you have customized any of these widgets and would like to update your customized widget, you can find the latest code in the corresponding Default Widget. Please remember that if you have a custom version of any of these widgets, our latest updates have not been pushed to your website.

- We updated the "Primary Membership Level" text to  "Primary Membership Plan" when editing a member through the "Quick Edit" workflow on the Search Members page in the Admin.

- We updated Stripe Payment Gateway logic in order to charge the most recently saved credit card when paying invoices. Also any old credit card information that has been saved previously will be deleted from Stripe whenever a new credit card is successfully added.

- We fixed an issue which was causing the system to duplicate the h1 and h2 tags on member search results pages when a Static Page is set to be used for the member search results page and it is using the Hero Image feature. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Member Results - Page Title

- We fixed an issue which was preventing the "Profile Statistics" link in the sidemenu of the Member Dashboard when the "Hide Manage Leads In Account Menu" Membership Plan setting was set to "Yes". Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Account - Sidebar

- We fixed an issue with the handling of special characters when importing members using the Member Import Tool.

- We updated the "Photo Gallery Previewer" Add-On in order to use the Add-On by default when it is activated on a site. Widgets Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Member Profile Bootstrap Theme - Search Results - Display Image Slider Bootstrap Theme - Single Post Page

- We updated the logic of member profile pages in order to hide the Overview tab if no content would display in the tab.  We also fixed an issue that would erroneously hide the tab even when some content would display in the tab. Widgets Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Member Profile - Display Member Address Bootstrap Theme - Pagination

- We fixed an issue which was preventing the system from displaying the videos a member had marked as "Favorite" / "Bookmarked" in the Member Dashboard in some cases.

- We fixed an issue which was affecting the ability to clone a member's post when the image of the post had been removed. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Account - Feature Single Photo Upload

- We added "Pending Approval" as a post status to filter by when viewing a member's posts in their Member Dashboard. This status option will be only available when the "Advanced Post Moderation" Add-On is active on a site. Widgets Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Account - Feature Body datatable Bootstrap Theme - Account - Photo Albums datatable

- We added a category search field to the "Listing Details" tab in the Member Dashboard area. This will help members find categories that apply to them when filling out their profile information. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Account - Select Categories

- We updated the layout of search results shown on static pages set to be "Member Search Results" in order to show 4 members per row when using the "Grid" view mode and the page has no Sidebar.

- We added a category search filter to the /categories page on the front-end of sites.  This will help users find categories they are interested in more easily. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Category Groups - Member Categories

- We moved the "Bulk Actions" dropdown to the blue header section of the Widget and Form pages in the Admin.

- We updated the notification badge shown in the "Leads" item in the Admin Sidebar Menu so that it will now show individual notification badges next to the "Chat Notifications" and "Manage Leads" sub-items individually when hovering the mouse over the "Leads" item in the menu.

- We improved the Member Import Tool in order to respect the "Pre-Select Top Category" Membership Plan setting when importing members to a site.

- We moved the styles of the Member Dashboard Menu on mobile devices from a widget to the main styles.css file used on the front end of sites. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Header - Main Menu

- We added the ability for the Admin of a site to choose whether or not to email the member or the reviewer after manually changing the status of a review to "Approved" on the Member Reviews page in the Admin.

- We fixed an issue which was preventing the Post Meta Details widget from properly displaying data when the post is using a default form. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Module - Post Meta Details v2.0

- We updated the layout of the Member Categories page in the Admin in order to move the lead price field next to the sort order field.

- We released the Bookmark Counter Add-On. Click here for more information. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Display - Add to Favorites Button
